steps.title: Pressurize
steps.text: Fill the line at 1.5–4 bar, within its normal working pressure.

steps.title: Walk the area
steps.text: Move the sensor slowly. Readings update every second.

steps.title: Pinpoint
steps.text: The highest reading marks the leak. On thick slabs, confirm with a pilot hole.

caption:
Find the leak before you break ground.

Water travels before it shows, so where it appears is not always where the leak is. A thermal camera shows where water has gathered; tracer gas leads you to where it escapes. A non-toxic, non-flammable mix of 5% hydrogen and 95% nitrogen goes into the line, escapes through the leak and rises through soil, concrete and tile to the sensor.

Pressurize the line, walk the area, follow the readings to the highest concentration. 30 minutes or less, even 10 ft deep or under a concrete slab. Any pipe material, no draining, and sensitive enough for the smallest pinholes.

No training, no calibration, no service plan. Manufactured in Lithuania (EU, CE marked), used in 40+ countries, with a 1-year manufacturer warranty and real support.
